metadata.interpretation: Conditional p=0 timing bypasses unresolved NumericalPolicy solely to price complete commit. Actual policy always rejects. No learning value or deployable acceptance evidence. Paired bootstrap intervals are block variability, not independent-run inferential intervals. Profile sums are not headline time. Separate 5ms resource profiles give sampled lower bounds on peaks; short peaks may be missed. Five comparison fixtures reside in this worker; process resource peaks are study working set, not a single model training footprint. RSS and Metal overlap and are never added. No checkpoint/trainer exists; checkpoint memory and full-cycle training throughput remain unmeasured.
